i just started a month and a half ago. invested because the gameplay seemed good, not braindead easy, still has a challenge. been able to clear mid level ish on dtide. and now my account could do jack shit on the mode that's meant to be available after the story stuff that has rewards. 

how many nerfs will be conducted covered as a 'bug fix'? how many changes will be made to make my money worth less in the game?

the changes make me regret ever spending on morimens. i can't even dare touch it now. whatever the goal was with the changes? well?. it didn't make the game more enjoyable. it made a paying player not even want to spend anymore, much more play. congrats on losing trust and faith. my post will be a statistic, a minus 1 out of tens of thousand players gone. at least the qualitative reason is on record.

just don't frame it as "for the good/enjoyment of the players" it's not fun thinking if the hundreds of bucks i spent would be worthless later.

<#1543760297637187614> just look at my meltdown in comparison of W5 normal to hard mode.

Im a semi casual. Used to pay and make sure to get most of the units I like to E3

I made an additional purchase 4 days ago, and I regret it.
I won't be spending any more money on this game.
I am absolutely heartbroken; I never imagined that a company I loved so much would hurt me like this. I am truly, deeply disappointed.

Of course, things might change if the game shows signs of promise again,
but looking at the current state of affairs, I might end up quitting sooner or later.

However, the way they are acting right now looks like nothing more than a power struggle with the players,
so I don't think I can ever trust this company again.

It is extremely difficult to regain trust once it has been lost.
There is nothing sadder than being betrayed by someone you trusted.
Honestly should have just added more difficulty stages the backlash from these changes aren't making the game look good <:Winkle_cry:1356082134447558748>
Let them suffer. They will learn

It really is sad, I don't know what theoretical whales they think they're gaining with these changes but they're going to lose the ones they hooked. They had me for a good 3 months, I bought every single pack they stuck in the game, every double currency pack, a hefty amount of nondoubled currency packs. I usually spend a pretty nice amount on whatever game I'm enjoying most, and after this week of silence they've lost me. Topped up my FGO account instead. I always wind up back there since they actually care about balance and my units don't randomly become unplayable in important stuff even after 9 years

I'm no +12 every single unit in the game kind of player, but those players are already giving as much money as is possible. The devs aren't squeezing more out of them, and all the other spenders spend less because there's no more point to spending a respectable amount when they've sucked the fun out of the game thrice over

Honestly, if they wanted to make more money,
they should have introduced engaging content to attract more players
and fixed the translation errors that kept cropping up.

Project Moon, which launched around the same time as this game and also started as a small studio, is now operating at a level far beyond what anyone could have imagined.
As long as there is a comparable peer, the issue simply comes down to their own competence.
In the past, thanks to the image the company projected, I was willing to overlook their occasional mistakes, errors, and slow content development—attributing them to factors like being a small company with limited financial resources.

However, in light of this recent situation, I have come to the conclusion that they simply lack competence.

I saw "Project Moon" in them.
But now, I cannot hide my disappointment.
They are throwing away the positive image they had built up all this time.

The longer the response to this situation is delayed, the deeper the public's disappointment will become.

And that will be irreversible.

Seeing a post like this in a situation like this...

They might really be completely thoughtless.
"Hello players, look at these cool cosmetics you could have if we actually put a day's worth of effort into making them like this random Reddit person did" <:24_clown:1468259444423921871>
